Finding: Overall observed hourly data coverage is 87.41%.
Interpretation: Some hourly energy observations are missing.
Data completeness differs across years. Annual totals should therefore be interpreted cautiously.

Finding: The observed dataset contains approximately 3434469 kWh across valid hourly records.
Interpretation: Observed energy records provide a starting point for energy-management planning, but do not represent a perfectly complete campus-wide measurement.

Finding: A hypothetical 10% reduction corresponds to 343447 kWh of observed baseline energy.
Interpretation: A 10% reduction is a hypothetical planning scenario, not an achieved or technically verified saving.

Finding: Lag-Based Regression reduced test-set MAE by 3.98% compared with the previous-hour baseline.
Interpretation: The lag-based model performed better on average, but its improvement was modest and not conclusive under the moving-block bootstrap analysis.
